title: Horizons Edge
description: This modpack adds vast terrain generation and a overall overhaul to minecraft while keeping a vanilla style.
body:
## Horizons Edge

Horizons Egde is a modpack desingned to keep the original feel and vanilla vibe of minecraft while adding vast terrain generation and structure generation that mould perfectly into minecraft without making it feel like an RPG game with 200 mods slapped on top.

This modpack's goal is to revive that 2 week phase and add a little twist of exploration and fun adding many vanilla+ style mods improving and overhauling most base game things such as audio, UI , shaders and many more! I hope anyone who tries this modpack enjoys it and has fun **:)** 



_**(WARNING not all Resource packs are compatible (such as Rainbows foliage and motschen's better leaves) experiment with them as you wish)**_
